Container.Name: pi-orca
Container.Overview: Official Pi with standard Orca integration. Full access inside an unprivileged container. Persistent HOME and shared workspace. Image updates are automatic; container updates are manual.

Config.Name: Persistent HOME
Config.Description: Whole HOME, owned by UID/GID 1000. Includes Pi sessions, Orca device keys and user packages.

Config.Name: Shared workspace
Config.Description: Existing shared workspace. Never recursively chown this directory.

Config.Name: Pairing LAN address
Config.Description: LAN address advertised during foreground pairing. Not a public Internet endpoint.
